subject.title: improve: let Code Mode use declared tool result shapes

question: Should `outputSchema` become a supported public plugin tool contract now, including post-hook validation of `AgentToolResult.details` for trusted catalog calls?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but accepting a new third-party plugin API and its long-term validation semantics requires maintainer ownership rather than model judgment.

options.title: Accept the public contract
options.body: Approve the additive field and documented validation semantics after confirming the generated plugin-manifest path preserves it.

options.title: Keep it runtime-internal
options.body: Limit result schemas to internal tools until the permanent plugin API and compatibility policy are designed separately.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers do not want to support declared plugin result contracts in the current release line.

recommendation.title: Accept the public contract
recommendation.body: Approve the additive field and documented validation semantics after confirming the generated plugin-manifest path preserves it.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work introduced and maintained the Code Mode catalog behavior this API extends.
